chain_words.nuance: to divide something into two or more parts
to separate something into parts along a line
to break something into many disconnected pieces
to break into many sharp pieces suddenly
to reduce something to fine dust or unrecognisable particles

explanation: These words all describe breaking things apart, from a simple break to a complete reduction into fragments.

usage_notes.difference: 'Fragment' describes breaking something into disconnected parts, often in a deliberate literary way; 'shatter' describes a sudden, violent breaking into sharp pieces.
